title: e2e-assure introduces Cumulo, the U.K.’s only sovereign, AI-driven, zero-day SOC platform to secure IT and OT environments
summary: e2e-assure has launched Cumulo, the U.K.'s only sovereign AI-first SOC platform that uses digital twin technology and customer-dedicated AI models to protect both IT and OT environments. The platform enables proactive threat detection and vulnerability identification before incidents occur, aligning with GCHQ's recent AI Cyber Shield initiative.
problem_solved: Addresses the need for sovereign, proactive cybersecurity solutions that can defend both traditional IT and operational technology environments against emerging threats and zero-day vulnerabilities.
why_valuable: As the only U.K. sovereign AI-driven SOC platform, Cumulo ensures data residency compliance while providing advanced AI-powered threat detection capabilities for organizations requiring guaranteed domestic data processing.
